title: Knowledge base
subtitle: The documents Sinji checks every claim against. What is marked public is also what the customer bot may quote.
readOnly: Members can browse, search and export the knowledge base. Importing, editing and deleting are limited to owners.

fields.title: Title
fields.tagsPlaceholder: Type a tag and press Enter
fields.metadataHint: Optional key/value pairs, for example product = cards or owner = retail.

validation.empty_key: Every metadata value needs a key.
validation.unsupported: {{name}} is not a supported file type.
validation.tooLarge: {{name}} is larger than the 25 MB limit.
validation.filesRequired: Choose at least one file to import.
validation.textRequired: Paste the text you want to import.
validation.textShort: That text is too short to index.
validation.csvRequired: Choose a CSV with question and answer columns first.

overview.loadFailed: Could not load the knowledge-base statistics.
overview.emptyBody: Import policies, tariffs and FAQs so fact-checks and the bot have something to stand on.
overview.updating_one: {{count}} document is being processed. This view updates on its own.
overview.updating_other: {{count}} documents are being processed. This view updates on its own.
overview.upToDate: Everything is indexed and up to date.
overview.byTypeHint: Select a type to filter the documents list.
overview.healthHint: How much of the base is searchable and how much the bot can see.
overview.noPublic: Nothing is public yet, so the customer bot has nothing it may quote. Publish documents from the Documents tab.

documents.caption: Knowledge-base documents
documents.noMatchBody: Try a broader search or clear the filters.
documents.emptyBody: Documents you import appear here with their status, visibility and chunks.
documents.nowPublic: Public: the bot may now quote this document.

retag.title: Retag documents
retag.addHint: These tags are added; existing tags stay.
retag.replaceHint: Existing tags on the selected documents are removed.

delete.title: Delete this document?
delete.bulkBody: The selected documents and all of their chunks will be removed. This cannot be undone.
delete.body_one: "{{title}}" and its {{count}} chunk will be removed from the knowledge base. Fact-checks and the bot stop using it immediately.
delete.body_other: "{{title}}" and its {{count}} chunks will be removed from the knowledge base. Fact-checks and the bot stop using it immediately.

edit.title: Edit document
edit.description: Change the details, or rewrite the content.
edit.savedRechunk: Saved. The document is being re-chunked and re-embedded.
edit.rechunkBody_other: The content changed, so its {{count}} chunks are rebuilt and embedded again. Manual chunk edits are replaced, and the document is briefly unavailable to fact-checks.
edit.rechunkBody_one: The content changed, so its {{count}} chunk is rebuilt and embedded again. Manual chunk edits are replaced, and the document is briefly unavailable to fact-checks.

chunks.noDocBody: Choose a document on the left to read its chunks exactly as retrieval sees them.
chunks.docMissing: That document could not be found.
chunks.inFlight: This document is being processed. Chunks appear when it is ready.
chunks.emptyBody: This document has no chunks, so it cannot be retrieved. Re-embed it to rebuild them.
chunks.emptyProcessing: Chunks will appear in a few seconds.
chunks.editDescription: The edited chunk is embedded again after saving.
chunks.saved: Chunk saved. It is being embedded again.
chunks.deleteBody: The chunk is removed from the document and from retrieval.

import.readOnly: Importing documents is limited to owners. Members can still use the template below to prepare a file for them.
import.filesBody: Supported: {{types}}. Each file becomes one document.
import.drop: Drop files here or choose from your computer
import.binaryNote: Text, Markdown and CSV files are read in your browser. In this demo, PDF, Word and Excel files get sample content based on the file name.
import.textBody: Paste a policy, a script or a procedure. Blank lines separate paragraphs.
import.csvBody: One row per question. The first row must name the columns question and answer (or კითხვა and პასუხი).
import.csvNoHeader: The first row must contain the column names question and answer, or კითხვა and პასუხი.
import.csvEmpty: No complete question and answer rows were found in this file.
import.question: Question
import.detailsBody: Applied to everything you import in this batch.
import.titleFilesHint: Used when you import a single file; otherwise each file keeps its own name.
import.restructureHint: Rewrites the text into headings and short bullet points before indexing. Takes a few seconds longer.
import.processingNote: They are processed in the background and turn Ready in a few seconds. Documents start as internal; publish the ones the bot may quote.
import.templateBody: A ready-made CSV with the right columns and three example rows. Fill it in and import it as a Q/A CSV.
import.visibilityBody: Imported documents start as internal. Only public documents can be quoted by the customer bot; internal ones still back fact-checks and retrieval for your team.
